connector.name: MCP Gateway by trusteed.xyz
connector.registryDescription: Agentic commerce gateway: discovery, search, checkout across Shopify/Woo/Odoo/PrestaShop.
connector.summary: Hosted at trusteed.xyz over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace xyz.trusteed, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OAuth 2.1 bearer token. Discovery via /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (RFC 9728). Public read tools work without auth; checkout tools require Bearer.
